entries.name: Constitutional Primacy
entries.body: The constitutional framework takes precedence over all other governance instruments.

entries.name: Human Sovereignty Guarantee
entries.body: Human decision-making authority is inviolable. AI systems advise; humans decide.

entries.name: Multi-Vendor Architecture
entries.body: The system must support multiple AI providers simultaneously. No single-vendor lock-in.

entries.name: Open Ontology
entries.body: The 12×12 lattice structure is publicly documented and freely implementable.

entries.name: Adversarial Review Requirement
entries.body: Every major routing decision must be reviewable by at least one adversarial Council seat.

entries.name: Dialect Sovereignty
entries.body: Each jurisdiction's dialect overlay has authority over its domain-specific routing rules.

entries.name: Provenance Chain Mandate
entries.body: All knowledge claims must carry verifiable provenance from source to current state.

entries.name: Zero Erasure Policy
entries.body: Committed knowledge artifacts are archived, never deleted. Superseded data remains accessible.

entries.name: Council Quorum Rules
entries.body: 0.67 quorum of active seats required for decisions. Provisional seats vote but don't count toward quorum.

entries.name: Convenor Authority
entries.body: The Convenor (human) holds tie-break authority and final ratification power.

entries.name: House Immutability
entries.body: The 12 Houses are fixed. New knowledge domains are accommodated within existing Houses or as sub-spheres.

entries.name: Sphere Addressing Standard
entries.body: Every sphere has a canonical address: H{n}-S{nnn}. Sub-spheres use SS-{nnnn} notation.

entries.name: VIP Element Registration
entries.body: New VIP Elements require Council supermajority and demonstrated cross-House impact.

entries.name: Sub-Sphere Expansion Protocol
entries.body: Sub-spheres may be added by any Council seat with 0.67 quorum approval. No upper limit per sphere.

entries.name: Cross-House Adjacency
entries.body: Adjacency relationships between spheres in different Houses must be explicitly declared and versioned.

entries.name: Ontology Migration Safety
entries.body: Schema changes must be backward-compatible within a major version. Breaking changes require new major version.

entries.name: Knowledge Node Completeness
entries.body: Every sphere must have at least one active sub-sphere. Empty spheres are flagged for review.

entries.name: Lattice Consistency Check
entries.body: Automated consistency checks run on every schema change. Inconsistencies block deployment.
